svg.text: Controlled job package: one approved configuration governs every setup below.
Before the new setup: previous-job items removed
or positively segregated so they cannot enter the active job
All resources match the same active configuration.
Mismatch / uncertain setup at any required check
Do not process the first board.
Use the approved board, material, tooling, program,
Return to the affected setup check, then repeat the required verification.
